subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should OpenClaw publish a current-session-scoped `resetSession(reason?)` capability specifically for `after_compaction` plugin hooks?
rationale: This creates a compatibility-sensitive plugin API, and the related plugin-wide reset proposal was closed unmerged; code review cannot infer whether maintainers want this permanent core contract.

options.title: Approve after-compaction-only API
options.body: Publish the capability only on `after_compaction` contexts with run-owner deferral and focused compatibility documentation and tests.

options.title: Design a generic lifecycle API first
options.body: Pause this PR until reset and other deferred session mutations share a maintainer-approved plugin lifecycle contract.

options.title: Keep reset internal
options.body: Reject the plugin API and solve the observed compaction loop through an internal compaction or context-engine continuation policy.

recommendation.title: Approve after-compaction-only API
recommendation.body: Publish the capability only on `after_compaction` contexts with run-owner deferral and focused compatibility documentation and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest history across both compaction policy and Gateway session-reset lifecycle.
